description: This file is an HTML document that implements a web-based database viewer interface. It includes styles and scripts to load and display database names, tables, and table data dynamically via API calls, providing interactive features such as refreshing, expanding cells, and navigation within a database visualization tool.
external_files: CSS styles embedded in `<style>` tags, script functions inline

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of available databases from the backend API.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, resets state, and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Handles expanding/collapsing a database's table list and fetches tables when needed.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Retrieves list of tables for a selected database and displays them.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data for the selected table, limiting records to a maximum of 50.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Creates HTML for displaying table data, including headers and rows.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Generates HTML for individual cell content, handling nulls, objects, and long text.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for better readability, supporting objects and long strings.
